messages:
lina: Support here — seeing a correlated spike in 502/504 and streaming timeouts starting ~03:12 UTC. Multiple customers (C-1123, C-1124, C-1127) reporting errors and long hanging streams.

lina: Affected: /v1/generate (streaming), /v1/chat/stream, some non-streaming requests also hit 504s after ~10s.

lina: Sample curl (from customer repro):
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{"model":"rw-large","stream":true,"max_tokens":1024,"prompt":"repeat x=10000"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# response: connection hangs then 504, client sees \"upstream read timeout\"
```

eve-oncall: oncall here. I see p95 RTT for /v1/generate spiking from 180ms -> 2.8s and a small spike in 502 rate at 03:12. Creating incident channel and sharding tracing.

ops-bot: Alert: hosted-api-inference frontend error rate exceeded threshold (502/504) at 2024-10-02T03:12:11Z. Top tags: region=eu-west-1, route=/v1/generate, backend=batcher-v2

mike-runtime: I can reproduce locally with a long streaming prompt when concurrency > 60. Getting KV cache thrash and some backend worker restarts logged as OOM-adj.

mike-runtime: quick log excerpt: 
```
worker-17 ERROR kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.82 seq_len=4096 memory_usage=0.93
proxy-frontend WARN upstream: connection reset by peer
```

derek-sre: Not seeing node-level OOMs on infra plane but autoscaler did kill a few GPU pods around 03:14 for node pressure. Could be cascading: autoscaler -> pod churn -> transient 502s.

amelia-product: Any customer impact severity? CS says multiple customers hit timeouts and one cancelled a production job. Need comms.

lina: Severity P2 for now, raising to P1 if we have sustained customer failures. CS is drafting a message.

mike-runtime: Mitigation we pushed: 1) reduce per-instance concurrency cap for batcher from 80 -> 32 (hotfix) 2) enabled short prefix caching for common prompts 3) disabled targeted runtime quant profiling that was hot-path today.

eve-oncall: Hotfix applied at 03:28. Error rates dropped back to baseline by 03:36. Rolling trace shows reduced latency for streaming sessions.

derek-sre: Follow-ups: check autoscaler thresholds for ephemeral GPU pressure and improve pod graceful shutdown timing to avoid dropping client streams.

mike-runtime: Repro steps captured: 1) spin up 100 concurrent stream requests (seq_len=4096) 2) send repeated long prompts 3) watch batcher mem and eviction counters. I saved a jmeter script in /incidents/artifacts/1758881234/repro.jmx

lina: CS -> customers: sent interim note at 03:40 UTC acknowledging the issue, listing mitigation and ETA for root-cause follow-up.

amelia-product: Action items (owners):
- @mike-runtime: write a postmortem section on KV cache tuning and why concurrency thresholds were insufficient (due 2024-10-04).
- @derek-sre: review autoscaler kill thresholds and adjust graceful terminate to 60s (due 2024-10-05).
- @eve-oncall: add a runbook step to lower batcher concurrency automatically when memory evictions > 0.5 for 2 mins (due 2024-10-03).
- @lina: consolidate CS comms and attach customer repro artifacts to the postmortem (due 2024-10-03).

mike-runtime: notes for postmortem: we should include sequence-length distribution, recent quant-profile rollout (canary ended 10/01), and a memory growth regression in batcher 2.1.8.

derek-sre: I'll pull kube events and autoscaler logs and attach timeline. Also recommend we add pod warmup capacity for EU region to avoid cold autoscaler churn.

eve-oncall: closing incident channel now, moving thread to follow-up. If anyone sees recurring spike reopen or @eve-oncall. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident closed by eve-oncall at 2024-10-02T03:48:12Z. Duration: 36m.

lina: Adding one more thing: customer asked for a mitigation flag to force non-streaming fallback for high-latency clients. Please note in product backlog.

amelia-product: Added to backlog: fallbacks & client-side retry guidelines. We'll prioritize in next sprint.
